draft.title: Time, continuity and change
card: Societies exist across time. Looking at how a society was in the past helps us understand how it is now.
something that stays the same over time, such as a custom, belief or institution that people keep passing on.
something that becomes different over time, such as a new law, a new technology or a shift in what people value.
Most societies show both at once. Studying continuity and change together helps explain why the present looks the way it does.
draft.remember: Every society has some parts that last and some that shift, and both help explain today.

a.q: Which statement best describes how continuity and change relate in a society?
opts: Most societies show both at the same time
A society shows continuity or change, never both
Change in one area means all areas must change
Continuity means a society has stopped developing
a.why: Some parts of a society last while others shift, so both usually appear together. Saying a society shows only one is wrong, because the card says most societies show both at once.
a.clue: Think about whether one society can have old customs and new technology.

b.q: A village in Tasmania has held a harvest festival every autumn for 150 years. Today the festival is advertised on social media. What is the social media advertising?
opts: An example of change
An example of continuity
An example of a custom
An example of an institution
b.why: Advertising on social media is a new way of doing something, so it is change. The yearly festival is the continuity, because people have kept it going for 150 years.
b.clue: Was social media part of the festival 150 years ago?

a.best: Most societies show both at the same time

problems.detail: The remember line says 'Every society has some parts that last and some that shift', but the card says only that 'most societies show both at once'. The remember line overstates the card and should say 'most' to match it.

check.summary: Both questions are sound and have one clear answer each. The remember line says 'every society' shows continuity and change, but the card says 'most', so the remember line should be changed to match.
